page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. Top: the title in large capitals with italic words, then the name of the praeses, then the candidate's name, date and place, then the printer's line and the year. Two ornaments are not transcribed.
page.notes: The year line is worn: it reads as cIↄ Iↄc XIV, transcribed as MDCXIV[?]. Two ornaments (a flourish above the printer's line and a small emblem below the date rule) are not transcribed. Show-through and stains from the other side are ignored. Printed page number, running head and signature: none.
